title: Stat card
description: One figure that matters, large, with its unit, a short label and an optional sentence. The marker number links the card to a numbered marker in a figure next to it.
instructions: Keep the label to a few words and the value to a number (format it for the course language). Put the unit in unit, not in value. Use marker only when a figure on the same screen shows the same number.

label.description: What the figure measures, in a few words.

value.description: The figure, formatted for the course language.

marker.description: Number of the matching marker in a figure on the same screen.

accent.description: Colour of the figure and of the glow.

props.label: Gained per orbit
props.body: For each m/s you brake, at 500 km.
